text.text:
Well it was done so that the later matches in 2-2 and 3-2 games are easier for top seeds.

If top seeds are given tough matches earlier(like in Cologne and Budapest) then they get easier matches in knockout games.

If top seeds are given easier matches first, then in Buchholz system, they would likely face tough opponents in knockout stage.
e.g. Paris major, where Navi and Faze had to face each other in a knockout game in group stages. Do you remember the teams that reached playoffs in Paris??

So to avoid that, they reversed the seeding matches.
